ControlPlaneUrl.Description: Base URL of the Deployz control plane the relay polls. NOT a credential.

EnrollmentCode.Description: Single-use code from your install link. Ties this installation to your deployment.

RelayCredential.Description: Server-established relay credential. When set, used as the secret value instead of generating one inside the account. Not a customer secret.

BootstrapVersion.Description: Version of the CDK Bootstrap resources in this environment, automatically retrieved from SSM Parameter Store. [cdk:skip]

Properties.Description: AWS CDK resource provider framework - onEvent (DeployzBootstrap/InstallIdProvider)
Server-established relay communication credential. Value was minted by the control plane and delivered via the Quick Create URL.
Bootstrap-generated relay communication credential. Minted by CloudFormation at deploy time; registered with the control plane on the relay first poll.
Maximum permissions for the Deployz relay execution role (union of phase 1 + phase 2). All within the deployz: tag boundary.
Post-first-contact provisioner permissions for the relay (phase 2). All within the deployz: tag boundary. Attached by the control plane.
Execution role for the Deployz relay Lambda. Least privilege (phase 1) with a permissions boundary; phase 2 provisioner policy is attached at install.
CloudFormation execution role for the Deployz application stack. Assumable only by CloudFormation on behalf of this account; every grant is scoped to the deployz: tag boundary where AWS supports it.
Permissions boundary of every IAM role the Deployz application stack creates.
Polls the Deployz control plane every minute (egress-only).

Assertions.AssertDescription: CDK bootstrap stack version 6 required. Please run 'cdk bootstrap' with a recent version of the CDK CLI.
